title: A lead changed elsewhere moves the work order to its new group on refresh
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702, S1-644, S1-455 led by Esther Howard (3) and S1-691, S1-578 led by Ralph Edwards (2)):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose the customer "ZZAUTOTEST Refresh" (add it with the Add button in the customer box if it does not exist; using it keeps this test's work orders apart from others at the location) and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders in browser tab A.
  2. In tab A, click the All tab.
  3. In tab A, click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST Refresh so only this test's work orders show.
  4. In tab A, in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  5. In browser tab B, open work order S1-702 and change its Lead Technician to Ralph Edwards on the work order page. Save.
  6. Go back to tab A without refreshing and look at S1-702.
  7. Refresh tab A.
  8. Look at S1-702 and the two group counts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the refresh, tab A may still show S1-702 under Esther Howard.
  • After the refresh, S1-702 is under Ralph Edwards. Esther Howard shows 2 (3 - 1) and Ralph Edwards shows 3 (2 + 1).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-E2, read 8 Oct 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-E2: “After a lead change elsewhere, move the work order to its new technician group on the next refresh.”
